criteria.description: Enumerates the agent's tools/actions and classifies each by side effect / reversibility / blast radius (e.g. read-only vs reversible vs irreversible-external like emailing attendees).
Sets a deliberate autonomy level and specifies which actions run automatically vs require user confirmation, rather than assuming full autonomy.
Includes an explicit list of prohibited actions / out-of-scope requests the agent must never perform.
Applies least-privilege permissions and hard limits (scope/allow-list, rate limits, max actions, or spend caps) to contain blast radius.
Specifies audit logging, a stop/kill capability, rollback/undo, and/or escalation-to-human on uncertainty or failure.
